title: Resistor network, Bourns 4600X SIP, dual terminator (104 circuit)
readingTypes: 46nnX104_rrr/sss or 46nnX_104_rrr/sss: nn the pin count, rrr the R1 code, sss the R2 code (221/331 = 220/330 ohm)
pinRule: pin 1 and pin nn are the two common lines (the datasheet: ground and power, respectively); each pin 2 to nn-1 is a line with R2 to pin 1 and R1 to pin nn, so a 4608X has 6 lines
datasheet: Bourns 4600X datasheet, page 2, Dual Terminator (104 Circuit)

sources.document: Bourns 4600X Series Thick Film Conformal SIPs, REV. 10/1/20

note: Datasheet text for the 4608X-104: an 8-pin part that terminates 6 lines; pins 1 and 8 are common for ground and power; twelve resistors paired in series between pins 1 and 8; 0.20 W per resistor at 70 C. The datasheet figure (page 2) joins every R2 to pin 1 and every R1 to the last pin (pin nn), each line pin sitting between its R1 and R2. So a 221/331 pack has 330 ohm from each line to pin 1 and 220 ohm to pin nn. Checked 2026-11-28 against card 3207 sheet 19: RN1 and RN3 have pin 1 on ground and pin 8 on the TERMS rail, so 220 ohm goes to TERMS and 330 ohm to ground (the usual SCSI terminator).
